search.aide: TikTok searches in 5 languages, about 30 videos per search: app phrasings, and every day the money topic (side hustle, online income).

curve.titre: Track the curve of spotted videos
curve.aide: 3 readings per video (H+6, H+24, H+48): by H+48 you know if it will break out.

tiktok.aide: 1 credit = an account's last 9 videos. Active accounts every day, quiet ones every 3 days, dormant ones every week: 9,000 readings cover 15,000 accounts.

insta.aide: The Instagram account given in a tracked account's TikTok bio. 1 credit = its last ~12 Reels, at the same pace as on TikTok.

transcript.aide: What is said in the videos that stand out most (2 minutes at most). 1 credit, nothing when there is nothing to transcribe.

ai.aide: Claude Haiku files each new hook under the family with the same idea, across languages. About $1 a month; cut first.

network.aide: Each followed app's keywords and hashtags: every 3 days for a competitor, every week otherwise. An account that names it joins its network.

ads.aide: TikTok and Meta ad libraries: an ad that runs for a long time is a format the app pays to push. Competitors every 3 days, others every week.

RadarFormats.compte: {n, plural, =0 {no formats} one {# format} other {# formats}}
RadarFormats.aucunTexte: A format shows up here as soon as two tracked accounts post the same on-screen text or the same sound within 14 days. Accounts are read every hour.

aide.reussis: at least 3 measured reuses, and one in two or more gets 3× its account's usual. A format is worth its reuses, not one viral hit.
aide.petent: at least 10,000 views and 3× its usual on one account, whether or not it works elsewhere.
aide.tous: any on-screen text or sound reused by two or more followed accounts within 14 days.
aide.familles: the same idea taken up in at least two languages. Claude (Haiku) files each new hook under the family with the same idea; it never rewrites or posts anything.

RadarFormats.reussiteAria: {wins} of {n} reuses get 3× their account's usual

RadarFormats.aucuneFamilleAide: New hooks are filed every 6 hours. A family shows up here as soon as the same idea circulates in two languages.
